edges.reason: msg.sender (untrusted) is passed as the receiver of _safeMint in adopt, so the caller controls the onERC721Received callback target.
adopt initiates _safeMint inside a mint loop, making an external call to the recipient before the loop completes.
onERC721Received invoked by _safeMint can re-enter adopt/giveAway minting logic.
_price is multiplied by num for the msg.value payment check in adopt.
Caller-supplied num is a factor of _price * num arithmetic in adopt.
_reserved state variable is the target of the _reserved -= _amount decrement in giveAway.
User-supplied _amount drives the _reserved -= _amount decrement in giveAway.
w1 is the recipient address of the low-level send in withdrawAll.
withdrawAll performs payable(w1).send(address(this).balance) via a low-level send.
adopt reads _reserved in the supply bound check (supply + num < 10000 - _reserved).
adopt reads _price in the msg.value >= _price * num requirement.
setPrice writes the _price state variable.
setBaseURI writes the _baseTokenURI state variable.
setReserved writes the _reserved state variable.
_baseURI reads _baseTokenURI for tokenURI construction.
getPrice reads the _price state variable.
getReserved reads the _reserved state variable.
initialize sets the initial _baseTokenURI value.
initialize sets the initial _reserved value.
initialize sets the initial _price value.
initialize assigns the treasury address w1 and mints token 0 to it.
Local supply in adopt is used to compute the minted token id passed to _safeMint.
Local supply participates in the supply + num arithmetic check in adopt.
Loop counter i in adopt drives the repeated _safeMint calls.
giveAway calls _safeMint to an owner-supplied address, triggering an external callback.
Owner-supplied _to is used as the _safeMint recipient in giveAway, controlling the callback target.
onERC721Received triggered by giveAway's _safeMint can re-enter the contract before _reserved is decremented.
Local supply in giveAway computes the minted token id.
Loop counter i in giveAway drives the repeated _safeMint calls.
Parameter baseURI is assigned to _baseTokenURI by setBaseURI.
Parameter _newPrice is assigned to _price by setPrice.
Parameter _newReserved is assigned to _reserved by setReserved.
Parameter _owner is queried in walletOfOwner.
Local tokenCount sizes the returned array in walletOfOwner.
Local tokensId is the returned enumeration array in walletOfOwner.
Loop counter i iterates owner token indices in walletOfOwner.
pause sets the state that the whenNotPaused modifier on _beforeTokenTransfer depends on.
unpause clears the state that gates _beforeTokenTransfer.
Minting in adopt flows through _beforeTokenTransfer (enumerable/pausable hooks).
Minting in giveAway flows through _beforeTokenTransfer.
onlyOwner authority guarded by _authorizeUpgrade is the same access control governing withdrawAll.

normalization_plan.reason: num is only meaningful as the caller-controlled mint count argument of adopt.
supply is a temporary inside adopt used for supply checks and token id computation.
the adopt loop counter i exists solely to drive the repeated _safeMint calls.
_to is the recipient argument passed directly into _safeMint in giveAway.
_amount directly determines the _reserved decrement magnitude in giveAway.
supply in giveAway only supplies the token id for _safeMint.
the giveAway loop counter i only drives repeated _safeMint calls.
baseURI is only the assignment source for _baseTokenURI in setBaseURI.
_newPrice is only the assignment source for _price in setPrice.
_newReserved is only the assignment source for _reserved in setReserved.
_owner is the address argument enumerated by walletOfOwner.
tokenCount is a transient size value inside walletOfOwner.
tokensId is the transient return buffer of walletOfOwner.
the walletOfOwner loop counter exists only to fill the return array.
